caption: The video captures a woman in a sage-green top and a long pale-pink skirt standing with her back partly to the camera in a pale-blue studio, facing a horizontal mirror above a ballet barre, with willow-like greenery hanging at left. Her reflection follows each movement, showing a single dancer. At the start her hands rest near her hips and her right foot points out to the side, a pose already underway. Her arms sweep outward, the left rising along a diagonal while the right extends down and out. Then both lift overhead as she keeps facing the mirror and the pointed foot draws in. The raised hands gather above her head, lower past her face and chest, and settle back onto her hips with feet together. From this position her arms again extend outward to the sides, her body rotating to a more sideways orientation. A foot points again as the arms spread, the motion continuing.
